title: P1c fix round 3 (combine): bring fix round 1 (explicit root, task/T-0473 at 62d26f1) and fix round 2 (root budgets and relevance, committed on task/T-0463 at e5e1689) onto one branch by cherry-picking 62d26f1 onto e5e1689, resolving recall.py so both intents hold; every T-0463, T-0473 and T-0475 acceptance test passes; full gate green
spec:
Fix round for T-0463 (P1c). Branch topology went wrong: fix round 1 (T-0473) committed 62d26f1 on its own branch task/T-0473 (explicit root parameter for recall(), spawn passes STATE's root; tests test_recall_uses_explicit_root_not_import_time_cwd, test_packet_memory_reads_from_monkeypatched_state), while fix round 2 (T-0475) committed e5e1689 directly on task/T-0463 (budgets from the root's pool.toml via configured_hits(root), relevance scoring with relevant=false hits; tests test_recall_budget_from_root_pool_toml, test_recall_index_entries_without_relevance_do_not_satisfy_budget) without fix round 1 underneath. Your worktree branch is cut from task/T-0463 at e5e1689.
1. git cherry-pick 62d26f1 (from task/T-0473) onto your branch. Resolve conflicts in skills/planner/memory/scripts/recall.py and tests so that both hold: recall(query, *, root=None, budget_hits=None, min_score=None, budget_chars=None, layers=..., task=None) resolves the root first (explicit root, else ORCH_ROOT, else cwd), derives every path (memory, tasks, pool.toml, graph) from that root per call, then resolves budgets from that root's pool.toml ([memory] table, then [limits].recall_hits, then defaults 8, 0.5, 6000) through configured_hits(root); cmd_index passes its resolved root; index entries without query relevance score 0 and never count toward sufficiency; spawn.memory_recall passes root=<parent of the current STATE>. No merge commit; a single cherry-pick commit (or a follow-up fix commit) is fine.
2. Verify: run the six named tests from the three fix rounds plus tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_gotcha_match_by_path and ::test_scout_packet_bounded_tree_and_memory_titles_only, then the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh; all green. Commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: the branch contains both 62d26f1's and e5e1689's changes with no merge commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
